name: skill-selector
description: AI Agent Skill 索引与冲突检测工具 — 扫描本地 SKILL.md 文件，提供关键词搜索排序和触发词冲突分析

scripts.start:proxy: cross-env HTTP_PROXY=http://YOUR_PROXY:8080 HTTPS_PROXY=http://YOUR_PROXY:8080 SKILL_VIZ_AUTO=0 node server.js
scripts.dev:proxy: cross-env HTTP_PROXY=http://YOUR_PROXY:8080 HTTPS_PROXY=http://YOUR_PROXY:8080 SKILL_VIZ_AUTO=0 node --watch server.js
scripts.dev:proxy:auto: cross-env HTTP_PROXY=http://YOUR_PROXY:8080 HTTPS_PROXY=http://YOUR_PROXY:8080 SKILL_VIZ_AUTO=1 node --watch server.js
